text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hi! I'm Tap Dance City.
Here marks the start of a romance-filled grand voyage!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll earn money through racing and build a castle where my friends and I can live full of fun and laughs!
And you'll train the 'World's Greatest Umamusume'!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's make that dream come true in grand style together!
Counting on you, Navigator!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
